fill.obs_text: The lexicon entries bear the grouping out. The codes of counting and reckoning are G3049 (to count, reckon; 4 occurrences), H2803H (to think, account, count; 6), H2803J (to think, imagine; 2) and G1380 (to think, regard; 1). The codes of attention by looking are H5027 (to look, regard; 3), H8159 (to gaze at, regard; 3), H7200G (to see, consider; 2), H7789 (to behold, regard; 1), H6485I (to attend to, visit; 1), H6437G (to turn toward; 2), H7919A (to be prudent, consider; 1) and G6063 (to know, perceive; 1). The codes of recognition and knowledge are G1097 (to know, recognise; 2), H3045 (to know; 3), H5234A (to recognise, regard; 1) and H0995 (to discern, consider; 1). The codes of taking up or setting are H5375Q (to lift, bear; 1), H5414I (to give, put; 1), H6188 (to count as uncircumcised; 1) and G2233 (to lead, to be chief; 2). The codes of a ground are H1700 (cause, matter; 1), G3313 (part, share; 1), G4012 (about, concerning; 1), H3820A (heart; 1) and H8104J (to keep, give heed; 1). H0408 and H3808 (not) negate the regard; H0853 (the sign of the object) and H9006 (the prefix from) are small words that carry no sense of regard. The codes that link the group to its usage are G3049, H2803H, H2803J and G1380 for the reckoning, and H5027, H8159, H7200G and H6485I for the look of attention.
